revisionLog.change: Corrected BTC buy-and-hold comparator description from 45% exposure to the existing 15% single-position cap so the written manifest matches the frozen simulator. Candidate model, features, costs, validation dates, and promotion criteria are unchanged.

researchQuestion: Can a simple cost-aware 24-hour expected-return forecaster outperform frozen TheOldTrader crypto v2 out of sample after the same conservative trading frictions?

data.notes: Coinbase warns historical candles may have gaps. The runner records missing-bar diagnostics and hashes the exact normalized dataset used.

costModel.reason: Historical top-of-book snapshots are unavailable from the candle endpoint. A fixed 10 bps round-trip spread is used for the primary comparison, with 0 and 35 bps sensitivity.

candidate.name: ridge24_cost_gate
candidate.sampling: one decision per UTC day per asset
candidate.entryRule: enter/hold long only when predicted 24h gross return exceeds the modeled round-trip cost; otherwise remain/exit flat
candidate.sizingRule: 15% of current equity per active asset, no discretionary leverage, maximum three assets / 45% total exposure

comparators: BTC buy-and-hold at the frozen 15% single-position cap
equal-weight BTC/ETH/SOL buy-and-hold at 45% total crypto exposure
simple 30-day time-series trend sign baseline at matching 15% per-asset cap
frozen TheOldTrader crypto v2 simulated from the unmodified live deriveCryptoSignal implementation

required: final-holdout Sharpe greater than frozen v2
final-holdout max drawdown no worse than frozen v2 by more than 20% relative
development walk-forward median fold Sharpe positive
positive net return in a majority of development folds
no single asset contributes more than 70% of total realized profit
primary result remains economically viable at 35 bps round-trip spread stress
promotionCriteria.note: Failure of any required criterion blocks promotion. No threshold/model rescue is allowed after holdout inspection; a changed method must receive a new experiment ID and manifest.
